title: Recursive-Head Geometry and Order-Free Efficient Inference in Finite-State Nested Markov Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.17939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exploiting the equality restrictions that nested Markov models encode requires their tangent-space geometry. For strictly positive finite-state models on arbitrary acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs), we differentiate the recursive-head chart and prove that the range of its score map is the full tangent space. Intrinsic-set coordinate blocks form an algebraic direct sum, blocks of distinct districts are orthogonal, and the resulting Gram projection needs neither mb-shieldedness nor a district order. Exact counterexamples show that observational centering and kernel normalization alone do not certify tangency. For the node, complete-source edge, and compatible path-specific intervention targets considered here, boundary substitution yields a normalized configured active law and an order-free canonical-gradient formula, extended to finite mixtures by independent source redraws. A coherent one-step estimator with an exact remainder iden

translated_title: 有限状态嵌套马尔可夫模型中的递归头几何与无序高效推断
translated_abstract: 利用嵌套马尔可夫模型所编码的相等约束需要借助其切空间几何。对于定义在任意无环有向混合图（ADMG）上的严格正的有限状态模型，我们对递归头图册进行求导，并证明其得分映射的值域为全切空间。内在集坐标块构成代数直和，不同区域的坐标块相互正交，由此得到的Gram投影既不需要mb-屏蔽性，也不需要区域顺序。精确构造的反例表明，仅凭观测中心化和核归一化不足以保证切空间相切性。对于本文所考虑的节点干预、完全源边干预以及相容的路径特定干预目标，边界替换方法产生了一个归一化的配置主动律和一个无序的典范梯度公式，并通过独立源重抽样将其扩展至有限混合模型。由此得到的具有精确余项的相容单步估计器……
tldr: 该论文通过微分几何方法证明有限状态嵌套马尔可夫模型中递归头得分映射张成全切空间，并借此建立了无需区域顺序和mb-屏蔽条件的高效典范梯度推断框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the score map of the recursive-head chart spans the full tangent space of finite-state nested Markov models, thereby establishing an order-free efficient inference framework via canonical gradients that requires neither mb-shieldedness nor district orderings.
